title: COALESCE — Display Preferred Name
description: Use COALESCE to display the first non-NULL name from multiple columns.

data.text: Write a query to display a contact name, preferring DisplayName, then FirstName + LastName, then 'Unknown' if all are NULL.

data.title: SQL Solution
data.code:
SELECT
    ContactID,
    COALESCE(
        DisplayName,
        FirstName + ' ' + LastName,
        'Unknown'
    ) AS PreferredName,
    Email
FROM Contacts
ORDER BY PreferredName;

data.title: Explanation
data.text: COALESCE returns the first non-NULL expression in the list. It accepts two or more arguments and evaluates left to right. ISNULL only takes two arguments. COALESCE is ANSI standard and works across databases. Use it for fallback/default value logic.
